kurz: Moist oven air keeps surfaces soft; dry air lets them brown and turn crisp.
bild_im_kopf: A dial between steam bath and sauna.
was_passiert: Steam condenses on cold surfaces and keeps them moist and stretchy. Dry air, especially from a fan, draws out water and lets crusts form.
faustregeln: For crispness, let the steam out at the end, e.g. by opening the oven door briefly.

params.links: moist: surface stays soft and stretchy
params.rechts: dry: a crust forms and browns
